title: The building on C Street
alt: Two-story red brick building with arched upper windows and a teal scalloped awning over the storefront; the windows carry Soozeezbeez Beetique bee decals.

title: The corner and the flower mural
alt: Low-angle view of the brick corner building with a tall painted mural of pink coneflowers on a golden sky and the teal awning wrapping the storefront.

title: From the alley
alt: Rear of the brick building from a walking path, showing the upstairs deck with a tan umbrella, metal stairs and a white door marked 320.

title: The balcony
alt: Sunny upstairs deck with a wicker loveseat, glass coffee table, patterned outdoor rug and a tan patio umbrella, looking over the street and neighbouring brick buildings.

title: Balcony and entry door
alt: Wicker sectional and glass table on the deck beside the brick wall and a white entry door with an arched transom window.

title: The living room in daylight
alt: Bright living room with a curved grey tufted sofa, round ottoman and floral rug on original hardwood floors, under exposed beams, silver ductwork and three tall windows.

title: The living room at evening
alt: The same living room with curtains drawn and warm string lights glowing on branch decor, a 'Bee Our Guest' sign and honeycomb shelves on the ivy-draped wall.

title: Arches, ivy and honeycomb
alt: Living room looking toward a white arched doorway and the hallway, with honeycomb shelves, a 'Bee Our Guest' sign and cascading ivy on the sage wall.

title: Exposed brick and fireplace
alt: Exposed red brick wall with a wall-mounted TV over an electric fireplace console, brass sconces and timber beams, beside an arched doorway.

title: Dining and workspace
alt: Desk with a bench and chair beside a dining table near two tall windows, under a glowing 'Bee Our Guest' neon sign and trailing ivy.

title: The kitchen
alt: L-shaped kitchen with warm maple shaker cabinets, concrete-look counters, stainless sink and dishwasher, fern garland above the cabinets and a small beehive figurine.

title: Bedroom
alt: Bedroom with a white carved bed and grey tufted headboard, navy throw, bee-print pillows and a floral rug with a large bee motif, beside a tall window.

title: Bedroom details
alt: Bed with bee-embroidered pillows facing a white dresser and arched mirror with trailing plants and brass lamps; a doorway shows patterned tile beyond.

title: The bathroom
alt: Sage bathroom with a backlit oval mirror, dark wood vanity, hexagon honeycomb shelves with small plants, a bee hand towel and a ruffled cream shower curtain.

title: The hallway
alt: Long hallway with original pine floorboards, a partly exposed brick wall and a cage sconce, leading through an arched doorway to the bright living room.

title: Susi Caregnato
alt: Susi Caregnato smiling in Soozeezbeez Honey BEEtique, wearing a yellow and peach crocheted shawl, with beeswax candles, honey dippers, jars of honey and bee mugs on the shelves around her.

title: Original storefront decal
alt: The original Soozeezbeez Beetique window decal: a honeybee framed by flowers and a banner, as it appears on the storefront glass.
